battle.name: 摩爾戰爭
battle.theater: 北非迦太基與薩丁尼亞海峽
battle.brief: 534 年汪達爾王國崩潰，摩爾人聯同薩丁尼亞的汪達爾殘部起兵，圍困島上拜占庭守軍於卡利斯，饑荒蔓延；536 年帝國收復薩丁尼亞，摩爾人退返北非，543 年再舉兵，游擊至 545 年才議和。卡面嘅秦連弩係戰國中國弩機，六世紀地中海並無此物，本役實戰靠複合弓、標槍、短劍同投石器。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰方分兩邊。東邊是拜占庭帝國，即羅馬帝國的東方半壁，最高決策在君士坦丁堡，前線由新設立的非洲軍政機構同各路將領分節制，兵員來自帝國正規軍、宮廷從軍兵、邊防守備軍，以及從汪達爾人同各地收編嘅俘兵。另一邊係北非摩爾人，即柏柏爾部族嘅聯盟，以斯泰爾托同庫齊納斯為首，旗下有摩爾步兵同騎兵，再加上逃到薩丁尼亞嘅汪達爾殘部。戰爭橫跨北非突尼斯、迦太基周邊同薩丁尼亞島，交戰雙方原本都係羅馬世界嘅人，卻沿族屬同效忠對象分裂開：帝國一方視摩爾人為叛附嘅外來盟友，摩爾人則指帝國拆散汪達爾王國、沒收土地、催逼糧稅。戰場形勢由糧食、船運同地形決定：海峽一側係島上兵力薄弱嘅帝國守軍，另一側係缺乏重裝步兵、只曉游擊嘅柏柏爾騎隊。
countriesEn: Two sides fought this war. On one side stood the Byzantine Empire, the eastern half of the Roman state, governed from Constantinople, with the front directed by a newly created military administration in Africa and by a series of generals; its manpower came from the regular army, the palace scholae, the frontier limitanei, and from captured Vandals and other auxiliaries absorbed into Roman units. On the other side stood the Moorish confederation of North Africa, that is, the Berber tribes, led by Steltho and Cutzinas, with Moorish infantry and cavalry and the surviving Vandals who had taken refuge in Sardinia. The fighting stretched across the Tunisian coast and Carthage in Africa and the island of Sardinia. Both belligerents originally belonged to the Roman world yet split along lines of ethnicity and allegiance: the empire treated the Moors as foreign auxiliaries turned rebel, while the Moors charged the empire with breaking up the Vandal kingdom, confiscating land and pressing harder for grain and taxes. The shape of the campaign was settled by food, shipping and terrain: a thin imperial garrison on one shore of the strait, and Berber horse on the other that knew how to skirmish but not how to stand in a line.
people: 皇帝查士丁尼一世係呢場戰爭最高嘅決策者：533 年派貝利撒留遠征汪達爾，534 年汪達爾王國崩潰之後將北非編為帝國行省，留低索羅門等官員治理，並下令追討汪達爾殘部。貝利撒留攻陷迦太基、迫降汪達爾王蓋利邁爾之後回師君士坦丁堡，535 年再赴意大利對付東哥特，無法兼顧北非。非洲方面由總督索羅門同將領約翰主持軍事，約翰出身保羅系官僚家族，543 年摩爾人起義時首當其衝。摩爾人一方以斯泰爾托為關鍵人物，他原本係帝國軍中摩爾人輔助部隊嘅指揮官，據說係一個穿希臘衣嘅野蠻人，起義後退入阿特拉斯山區，游擊數年；庫齊納斯立場更硬，係唔肯罷休嘅柏柏爾首領。汪達爾人方面，蓋利邁爾於 534 年 3 月投降，其兄阿馬拉里克早於 525 年陣亡；至於 536 年薩丁尼亞失守後逃回迦太基嘅斯泰爾托，正係佢將北非柏柏爾部族拖入戰局。
peopleEn: Emperor Justinian I was the ultimate decision maker in this campaign: he sent Belisarius against the Vandal kingdom in 533, and once the Vandal state collapsed in 534 he turned North Africa into an imperial province, left officials such as Solomon to govern it, and ordered the hunt for the remaining Vandals. Belisarius captured Carthage and took the Vandal king Gelimer captive, then returned to Constantinople; in 535 he was sent to Italy against the Ostrogoths and could not spare attention for Africa. In Africa the command lay with the governor Solomon and the general John, son of Paul the prefect, who bore the brunt of the Moorish rising of 543. On the Moorish side the key figure was Steltho, formerly commander of Moorish auxiliaries in Roman pay, described as a savage dressed in Greek who after his revolt withdrew into the Atlas mountains and carried on a guerrilla war for years; Cutzinas was the more obstinate Berber chief, unwilling to give up. Among the Vandals, Gelimer surrendered in March 534, his brother Amalric having fallen in 525, and Steltho, driven out of Sardinia in 536, fled to Carthage and dragged the Berber tribes of North Africa into the war.
kits: 卡面嘅秦連弩係戰國中期秦國已經用緊嘅弩機：踏張、扣機、上弦，一具可以連續放箭，設計原點係弩機配車床，用嚟壓住攻城人馬，唔使人每發都再拉一次弦。呢件兵器喺地中海世界從來冇出現過，羅馬人到 6 世紀仍然只有手拉式強弩即 arcuballista，同較輕嘅 cheiroballista，攻城靠配重投石器 onager 同 ballista 配攻城塔。本役真正落喺戰場上嘅裝備：帝國軍用羅馬式複合弓配鐵鏃、標槍 pila、長矛 hasta、雙刃短劍 spatha 同柄劍，配大橢圓盾 scutum 或者小圓盾 parma，甲冑有鱗甲、鎖子甲同頭盔，另有具裝騎兵同弓騎兵；摩爾人同汪達爾殘部用柏柏爾式小圓盾、投石索、皮甲、馬刀同標槍，騎兵比例高，靠山地同機動作戰。攻城同守城雙方都動用帆布攻城塔、破城槌同配重投石器；海路靠運兵船同划槳戰艦維持薩丁尼亞同北非之間嘅補給，羅馬船隻沿岸取淡水同食糧。武器年表上，弩機喺東亞係公元前 3 世紀已成熟嘅技術，地中海最接近嘅係亞歷山大時代嘅 helepolis，兩者相隔逾千年又隔住大半個歐亞，冇任何證據顯示秦式連弩同本役有過交集。
kitsEn: The repeating crossbow on the card is a weapon Qin had in use by the middle of the Warring States: a treadle draws the stock, a trigger catches the string, and a magazine lets one operator loose a series of bolts. Its design point was to hold an enemy pressing at a wall without the archer having to draw the string again for every shot. No such weapon ever existed in the Mediterranean world. In the sixth century the Romans still had only hand-drawn crossbows, the heavy arcuballista and the lighter cheiroballista, while siege work was done by counterweight stone-throwers, the onager and the ballista, backed by siege towers. What actually went into battle in this campaign: imperial troops used the Roman composite bow with iron arrowheads, javelins and spears, the double-edged spatha and the single-edged sword, and were equipped with the large oval scutum or the small round parma, with scale and mail armour and helmets; cataphracts and mounted archers gave them mobility. The Moors and the surviving Vandals carried small Berber round shields, slings, leather armour, curved sabres and javelins, with a high share of horsemen who fought from mountains and kept moving. Both sides brought up canvas-covered siege towers, battering rams and counterweight throwers; at sea, troop transports and galleys kept the line between Sardinia and Africa supplied, with Roman ships taking on fresh water and grain along the African coast. On the timeline of weapons the magazine crossbow was a mature East Asian technology of the third century BC, and the closest Mediterranean relative was the Hellenistic helepolis; the two lie a thousand years and most of a continent apart, and no evidence connects the Qin repeating crossbow with anything that happened in this campaign.
tactics: 本役戰術可以分三段睇。薩丁尼亞一段，摩爾人同汪達爾殘部以海路奇襲登陸，利用島上守軍分散、彈藥存量有限嘅弱點，先以騎兵衝擊殲滅外圍巡邏隊，再圍困卡利斯；圍城曠日持久，靠封鎖海路同切斷島上物資，逼守軍耗盡糧食，最後以有條件撤走收場，守軍得脫但全島落到敵手，饑荒蔓延，居民大批逃往科西嘉同北非。536 年帝國反攻，部隊以海軍掩護登陸，切斷敵方退路，逼摩爾人放棄島嶼退回北非。北非一段，摩爾人放棄正面會戰，改用阿特拉斯山區嘅游擊：唔同帝國重裝步兵正面對撞，專打分散嘅徵糧隊、輔兵營同運糧車隊，用熟悉嘅山路切斷羅馬軍隊縱隊，切成一段一段消耗，再以騎兵快速轉進同退走。帝國方應對手法係築圍城、封鎖山路、逐點清剿，同時靠海運接濟，唔敢一次過把大軍推入山區。最後雙方都靠封臣化收場，帝國承認摩爾首領部分地盤同部眾，換取停戰，再將摩爾人編入輔助部隊，令其為帝國作戰。
tacticsEn: The campaign reads in three phases. In Sardinia the Moors and the surviving Vandals landed by surprise from the sea, exploiting a garrison that was thin and scattered and short of ammunition: cavalry first destroyed the outlying patrols, then the siege of Caralis began. It dragged on because the besiegers blockaded the sea and cut the island off from its supplies, wearing the garrison down until it agreed to leave under terms, so the Roman soldiers escaped but the island fell, famine spread, and inhabitants fled in large numbers to Corsica and Africa. The imperial counterstroke in 536 landed under naval cover, cut the defenders off from their retreat and drove the Moors off the island back to Africa. In North Africa the Moors gave up pitched battle for a guerrilla war in the Atlas ranges: they refused to meet imperial heavy infantry in the open, struck instead at scattered tax parties, auxiliary camps and supply convoys, used their knowledge of the tracks to cut Roman columns into pieces, and then rode off before the line could answer. The imperial answer was to invest, seal the passes and clear strongholds one by one, keeping the army supplied by sea rather than pushing a mass of troops blindly into the mountains. The settlement came through client status: the empire recognised part of the Moorish chiefs' territory and their followers in exchange for peace, and then took the Moors into auxiliary units that fought for Rome.
data: 可以引用嘅數字大致咁樣：533 年遠征汪達爾嘅帝國軍，步兵約三萬五千、騎兵約五千，連海軍合計接近四萬，艦隊數百艘；同年 9 月 17 日迦太基陷落，蓋利邁爾翌年 3 月投降，帝國從國庫攞走大量金銀同珠寶，被押走嘅汪達爾人以萬計，估計由數十萬人，部分被編入羅馬軍隊。534 年 8 月 30 日，東哥特王狄奧多里克大帝喺拉韋納病逝，令北非摩爾人失去最重要嘅奧援。薩丁尼亞一段，帝國守軍只係一支小型駐軍，圍城歷時數月，島上饑荒嚴重到出現食草根同動物嘅記載。543 至 545 年北非起義，帝國投入兵力遠超島上一役，但被山區游擊拖到必須議和；以萬計嘅摩爾人最後被收編入帝國軍隊，另有部分被派往意大利戰線。戰役由 534 年延續到 545 年，橫跨十一年。航線上，迦太基到薩丁尼亞約三百公里，順風航行兩三日可到；羅馬到義大利北岸航程超過一千二百公里，補給完全依賴海運。
dataEn: The numbers that can be quoted with confidence are roughly these. The imperial force sent against the Vandals in 533 numbered about 35,000 foot and 5,000 horse, close to 40,000 men in all once the marines are counted, with several hundred ships. Carthage fell on 17 September 533 and Gelimer surrendered in March 534. The empire carried away large quantities of gold, silver and gems from the treasury, and the number of Vandals taken into captivity ran into the tens of thousands, with estimates reaching several hundred thousand; part of them were enrolled in Roman units. On 30 August 534 Theodoric the Great died at Ravenna, depriving the North African Moors of their most powerful patron. In Sardinia the imperial force was only a small garrison, the siege ran for months, and the famine on the island was bad enough to leave records of people eating grass roots and animals. The rising of 543 to 545 in North Africa committed far more imperial troops than the island campaign had, yet mountain fighting dragged on until terms had to be discussed. Tens of thousands of Moors were eventually absorbed into the imperial army, and some were sent to the Italian front. The campaign runs from 534 to 545, eleven years in all. On the sea, Carthage lies about 300 kilometres from Sardinia, two or three days sail in a following wind, while the run from Rome to the north Italian coast exceeds 1,200 kilometres, so supply depended entirely on shipping.
cause: 起火原因有三層。第一層係汪達爾王國本身崩潰：534 年初迦太基陷落、汪達爾王蓋利邁爾投降，帝國接管北非，解散汪達爾軍團，將土地分封予拜占庭官員同汪達爾降卒，把北非嘅行政同稅制改造成帝國式樣。第二層係汪達爾人同摩爾人嘅舊盟約：北非統治長期依賴摩爾人輔助部隊，薩丁尼亞亦有汪達爾守軍常駐，帝國接管令呢批人同時失去職位同土地。第三層係東哥特局勢：534 年 8 月 30 日狄奧多里克大帝喺拉韋納病逝，其女阿瑪拉桑莎同外孫歐塔里烏斯入主米蘭，拜占庭隨即撤銷東哥特王室嘅羅馬元老頭銜，並喺 536 年同法蘭克人、阿勒曼尼人訂約，令意大利戰線同北非戰線同時拉緊。於是汪達爾殘部同摩爾人選擇先打北非同薩丁尼亞這條較易防守嘅線，用嚟削弱帝國對意大利嘅進攻準備。
causeEn: The conflict had three layers of cause. The first was the collapse of the Vandal kingdom itself: with Carthage fallen in early 534 and the Vandal king Gelimer surrendering, the empire took over North Africa, dissolved the Vandal military units, distributed their lands to Byzantine officials and surrendered Vandals, and reshaped the administration and taxation of the province along imperial lines. The second was the old alliance between Vandals and Moors: the rule of North Africa had long rested on Moorish auxiliary troops, and a Vandal garrison remained on Sardinia, so the handover stripped these men of both office and land at the same time. The third was the Ostrogothic situation. On 30 August 534 Theodoric the Great died at Ravenna, and his daughter Amalasuntha and her son Athalaric took over in Milan; the Byzantines promptly withdrew the Roman senatorial rank from the Ostrogothic royal house, and in 535 they made an alliance with the Franks and the Alamanni, stretching the Italian front and the North African front at the same time. The surviving Vandals and the Moors therefore chose to strike first on the more defensible line through North Africa and Sardinia, in order to weaken the empire's preparations for the attack on Italy.
impact: 摩爾戰爭最直接嘅影響係北非：拜占庭非洲行省成立，迦太基、突尼斯、傑米拉、提比西亞等城市重新納入帝國稅網同教會網絡，希臘語同基督教喺北非城市復甦，羅馬法與羅馬稅制落地，為之後幾個世紀嘅地中海帝國秩序打下基礎。第二個影響係北非成為帝國最重要嘅糧倉同兵源，阿非利加嘅穀物運往羅馬同君士坦丁堡，摩爾人、汪達爾人被大量編入帝國軍，其後嘅東哥特戰爭、倫巴底戰役同阿拉伯戰役都有呢批輔助兵嘅身影。第三，541 年起嘅查士丁尼瘟疫沿迦太基上岸，擊穿帝國喺北非嘅駐軍同城鎮，令 543 年摩爾人起義時守軍虛弱、士氣低落，疫情同時由海路傳入意大利，削弱咗拜占庭對東哥特作戰嘅底子。第四，薩丁尼亞自 536 年起成為帝國控制西地中海航路嘅前哨，但呢種控制並不長久，八世紀阿拔斯王朝屬下嘅回軍同阿拉伯海盜多次襲擊島上城鎮，島嶼分崩離析，最後落入比薩同熱那亞嘅爭奪。第五，呢場戰爭確立咗以封臣、附庸同收編軍隊嘅方式處理外族嘅帝國政策，成為之後幾百年拜占庭對付柏柏爾人、斯拉夫人同阿瓦隆人嘅標準做法。
impactEn: The most direct effect of the Moorish war fell on North Africa. A Byzantine African province came into being, and cities such as Carthage, Tunis, Jamiila and Thysdrus were drawn back into the imperial network of taxation and church organisation; Greek and Christianity revived in the African cities, and Roman law and Roman taxation took root, laying the foundation for the imperial order of the Mediterranean over the following centuries. The second effect was that North Africa became the empire's most important granary and source of soldiers: the grain of Africa was shipped to Rome and Constantinople, and large numbers of Moors and Vandals were enrolled in imperial service, appearing later in the Gothic war, the Lombard campaigns and the Arab wars. Third, the plague of Justinian, which began in 541, came ashore at Carthage and broke the imperial garrison and the towns of the province, leaving the defenders weak and low in spirit when the Moors rose in 543; the same disease reached Italy by sea and weakened the ground on which Byzantium meant to fight the Ostrogoths. Fourth, from 536 Sardinia served as a forward post for the empire's command of the western Mediterranean sea lanes, but that control did not last: in the eighth century the forces of the Abbasid caliphate and the Arab raiders struck the island's towns again and again, the island broke into fragments, and it finally fell into the rivalry of Pisa and Genoa. Fifth, this war fixed the imperial policy of handling foreign peoples through client status, vassalage and enrolment in the army, which became the standard Byzantine method for dealing with Berbers, Slavs and Avars over the centuries that followed.
result: 分區睇結果。薩丁尼亞：534 至 535 年被摩爾人同汪達爾殘部攻陷，島上守軍退守卡利斯之後撤出，全島淪為焦土，饑荒蔓延，人口大量外流；536 年帝國派海軍同登陸部隊收復全島，摩爾人退回北非，島上重設帝國行政同教區。迦太基同北非：汪達爾王國於 534 年正式終結，但摩爾人嘅武裝抵抗冇停，543 年起斯泰爾托帶領柏柏爾部族起義，退入山區游擊，帝國以圍剿、封鎖同議和交替處理，約 545 年後戰事平復，摩爾首領取得部分地方嘅附庸地位，其部眾被收編入帝國軍隊。整體結果係拜占庭守住北非同薩丁尼亞，但付出代價：戰線由意大利增加到北非同薩丁尼亞，疫情同兵源流失削弱咗帝國，摩爾人亦由輔助兵變成需要長期監視嘅附庸。而呢場戰爭並未能阻止帝國喺 535 年之後全力對付東哥特，554 年東哥特王國覆亡，但拜占庭會喺 698 年失去迦太基，摩爾人世界亦會喺阿拉伯征服之下改變面貌。
resultEn: The result differs by theatre. In Sardinia the island was overrun in 534 and 535 by the Moors and the surviving Vandals; the garrison withdrew from Caralis and sailed off, the whole island became a burnt waste, famine spread and a large part of the population was displaced. In 536 the empire sent fleets and landing troops to recover the island, the Moors fell back to Africa, and imperial administration and bishoprics were restored there. At Carthage and in North Africa the Vandal kingdom formally ended in 534, but armed Moorish resistance did not stop: from 543 Steltho led the Berber tribes in revolt and withdrew into the mountains to fight a guerrilla war, and the empire alternated between hunting them down, sealing the passes and negotiating. By about 545 the fighting had died down, the Moorish chiefs gained client status over part of their territory, and their followers were enrolled in the imperial army. The overall result was that Byzantium held North Africa and Sardinia, but it paid for it: the front stretched from Italy to North Africa and Sardinia, plague and the loss of manpower drained the empire, and the Moors turned from auxiliaries into vassals that had to be watched for a long time. None of this stopped the empire from throwing its full weight against the Ostrogoths after 535; the Ostrogothic kingdom was destroyed in 554, but Byzantium lost Carthage in 698, and the Moorish world itself was remade by the Arab conquest.
